How it works

  1. 01

    Connect channels

    Link the client’s Facebook, Instagram, Threads, LinkedIn, YouTube, Pinterest or GBP accounts to the workspace.

  2. 02

    Compose or import

    Draft in the composer, pull from a set, or upload a CSV. Add media, tags, signatures and an optional first comment.

  3. 03

    Schedule and publish

    Pick a time, use best-time hints, or set evergreen/repeat. Approve if your workflow requires it — then it goes out on schedule.

FAQ

Which platforms can I publish to?+

Facebook, Instagram, Threads, LinkedIn, YouTube, Pinterest and Google Business Profile from the same composer.

Can I schedule many posts at once?+

Yes. CSV bulk import maps caption, media and publish time so you can load a month of content in one pass.

What is evergreen posting?+

Mark posts to recycle on a cadence so evergreen offers and tip content keep running without rewriting every week.

Ready to run client social from one desk?

Create a workspace in a minute. Connect channels, invite your team, and keep every approval in one queue.
